about_the_game:
Unleash Strategic Destruction - Leadbelly is a hand-drawn, narrative-driven deckbuilder. Build your deck from a growing arsenal of cards, adapt to three rival factions — Oil, Gas, Electric, and Gunpowder — and exploit their weaknesses to unleash devastating combos as you blaze a trail of vengeance.

A Story-Fueled Campaign - Leadbelly isn't just about survival, it's about revenge. From scorched wastelands to electrified fortresses, each act culminates in a powerful boss battle guarding a piece of your past. With every victory, you peel back the layers of a mystery far bigger than you imagined.

An AI Companion with a Mind of Its Own - You're not alone inside the steel shell of your prison. A quirky, unpredictable AI-buddy bot rides alongside you, offering tactical advice, cryptic insights, and maybe even a bit of friendship.

Upgrade Through Meta-Progression - Every failure is fuel for your comeback. Unlock new cards and relics that persist between runs. Fine-tune your deck to match your playstyle, and turn every scrap of experience into firepower.

Hand Drawn & Animated - From the grimy bolts of your tank to the haunting wastelands you roam, Leadbelly is fully hand-drawn and hand-animated by a developer with 20 years of industry experience.

Features

  • Four enemy factions, each with unique mechanics and weaknesses

  • A narrative campaign with boss battles that reveal your stolen past

  • Meta-progression: unlock cards and relics that persist between runs

  • A quirky AI companion with its own personality and agenda

  • Fully hand-drawn and hand-animated art and characters

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: You're a brain in a jar, wired into a war tank, and someone is going to pay. Leadbelly is a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder where you build your deck, crush enemy factions, and unravel who stole your body — with a quirky AI riding shotgun.
